integrity: All-dimensional proof uses explicit sign-matrix reduction and sharp deficit inequalities; finite exhaustive rational checks are supporting evidence, not a proof in unbounded size. No independent scientific audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only ambient Euclidean diameter in the fixed standard-coordinate shuffle for m,n>=2 and alpha,beta>=0; no complete supercritical formula and no graph metric statement. Equivalent prior results under alternate terminology remain possible.
title: Sharp two-parameter Euclidean-diameter stability for simplex shuffles
